response.sql: WITH winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank or missing)') AS hand FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id), hand_counts AS (SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count FROM winners GROUP BY hand) SELECT hand, winner_count, winner_count * 1.0 / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts ORDER BY hand

assumptions.assumption: A winner is a distinct player, even if they won multiple manager awards.

alternatives.interpretation: Count award wins instead, so a player who won multiple manager awards is counted multiple times.
